name: ChapterHero - With Image
description: The city banner, now the shared page banner every surface on the site opens with, in its photo tone. It used to be a header of its own design that filled the screen below the nav, so a reader met a photo and a title and had to scroll before learning the page had any content; it is now left-aligned and height-capped. The title used to read Harvard Alumni in Tech plus the city, which was strained for a place and actively wrong for a group - the AI community's banner announced HARVARD ALUMNI IN TECH AI, which reads as a product rather than people. The organisation's name moved into the small uppercase kicker above, leaving the city as the title. That split is also what gives a forming city somewhere honest to say what it is, since the kicker can read Online group without touching the title.
